title: Supplement pour le Marquisat de Brandebourg ou se trouve la Vieille Marche et le Quartier de Pregnitz
own_graticule_range: longitude 29-31, latitude 52-53 on the inset's own border graduations
reason: the supplement carries its OWN graduated border and its own layout; applying the main plate's transform to it would place the Altmark and Prignitz at fictitious positions
resolved_by_blha_reason: the ca.1758 BLHA sheet does draw the Altmark and Prignitz in its main field, but that resolves the BLHA sheet, not the BnF inset. A gap in one source is not closed by another source.
